# sherpa-app-header

The top application header bar.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | nav |
| Figma | App Header |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-app-header/sherpa-app-header.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-app-header/sherpa-app-header.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-app-header/sherpa-app-header.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-app-header/sherpa-app-header.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-app-header/sherpa-app-header.example.json) |

## When to use it

For the bar across the top of the app: the Context's title (`data-heading`), its breadcrumbs, its filters and the app's actions. `sherpa-app-shell` draws one by default; for a heading above one section of a page, use `sherpa-section-header`.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-app-header data-heading="Records" data-icon="table-columns" data-ai data-theme-toggle data-notifications data-account data-help></sherpa-app-header>
```

`populate()` is given, on `sherpa-app-header`:

```json
{
  "breadcrumb": [
    {
      "label": "Home",
      "href": "?context=home"
    },
    {
      "label": "Records"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-account` | boolean |  | show the account button |
| `data-ai` | boolean |  | show the "Ask N-zo" AI button |
| `data-ai-label` | text | `Ask N-zo` | its label |
| `data-back` | boolean |  | show the back button |
| `data-custom-view` | boolean |  | the View on screen is the reader's own: Delete view shows. TRAP T-a-saved-view-is-the-readers-own |
| `data-favourite` | boolean |  | the ★ is lit — the value, IN |
| `data-graph` | boolean |  | the View on screen is a graph: Save graph as, Delete graph. TRAP T-a-graph-is-a-view-of-a-type |
| `data-heading` | text |  | the Context title (row 2) |
| `data-help` | boolean |  | show the support button |
| `data-icon` | text |  | the Context icon — an icon name ("gauge") |
| `data-labs` | boolean |  | show the labs/beaker button |
| `data-loading` | boolean |  | run the indeterminate loading bar |
| `data-locked` | boolean |  | the host owns the ★: report the click, never light it |
| `data-menu` | boolean |  | show the app-switcher button |
| `data-no-filters` | boolean |  | no filter row: the Context's page holds its filters (a Context's `chrome.filters: false`). TODO 425 |
| `data-notifications` | number |  | unread count — shows the bell + its badge |
| `data-notifications-open` | boolean |  | the HOST's panel is open, so the bell wears its open ring. The header emits the intent; the host owns the panel and reports the state back. TRAP T-a-trigger-shows-what-it-opened |
| `data-query` | boolean |  | the graph on screen is a page's Query: each edit is the page's, so the View's actions — ★, Save and its menu — are not shown |
| `data-readonly` | boolean |  | the View on screen is read only, a preset graph: Save is off |
| `data-theme-mode` | `light` `dark` |  | light \| dark — the mode on screen; the button offers the other |
| `data-theme-toggle` | boolean |  | show the light/dark (moon) button |
| `data-view-actions` | boolean |  | show the View's own actions on the top row, left of Ask N-zo: ★, and Save with Save view as and Delete view. They never move, so they are the header's, not a toolbar's. Will, TODOs 425 G9 and 428 |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `back-click` |  |  |
| `ai-click` |  |  |
| `labs-click` |  |  |
| `theme-toggle` |  |  |
| `notifications-click` |  |  |
| `account-click` |  |  |
| `help-click` |  |  |
| `menu-click` |  |  |
| `view-favorite` | `{ favourite: boolean }` | The ★ was pressed, a request. |
| `view-save` |  | Save, a request a host may take over (cancelable). A host may call `preventDefault()` to take it over. |
| `view-save-as` |  | Save view as (Save graph as), cancelable. A host may call `preventDefault()` to take it over. |
| `view-delete` |  | Delete view (Delete graph), the reader's own; cancelable. A host may call `preventDefault()` to take it over. |
| `nav-menu-request` |  | The mobile nav menu, right of the title. |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `breadcrumbs` | nav | the breadcrumb trail (row 1, left) |
| `heading` | text | rich Context title (overrides data-heading) |
| `actions` | control | extra buttons before the standard action set |
| `filters` | toolbar | the quick-filter toolbar (row 2) |
